input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term. Vendor warrants it has authority to enter the Agreement and grant the rights stated here.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets or exceeds our preferred position. Vendor gives a professional and workmanlike services warranty measured against industry standards (19.1), a documentation/specification conformity warranty with a 90-day Deliverable period running from the later of delivery or acceptance and hosted Services conformity for the entire subscription term (19.2, better than the 12-month software benchmark), plus compliance with Applicable Law and a no-malicious-code warranty (19.3). Section 19.4 supplies the required remedy of prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid, and is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The disclaimer in 19.5 is limited to implied warranties and expressly states that no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranties. No redline needed.
